action.description: Action to perform. One of the listed values; anything else returns the closest matches.

args.description: The action's parameters, named as its signature names them.

check_structure.summary: Check the object ownership UWidgetBlueprint::ValidateGeneratedClass asserts, the usual suspect when a Widget Blueprint hangs or crashes the editor on compile or load: the designer WidgetTree is outered to the blueprint and every widget in it to that tree, and the generated class's archetype tree (the _C:WidgetTree prototype) is outered to the class and every widget in it to that archetype. Every object comes back with its path, expectedOuter, actualOuter and pass, plus unreachableWidgets (owned by the tree but in no hierarchy), and a pass/failures summary (#1350).

get_properties.summary: Full reflected property dump for a widget - every UPROPERTY (RenderOpacity, Visibility, ColorAndOpacity, Border padding/colors, Image brush TintColor/ImageSize, fonts, etc.) plus the slot block, for diagnosing visual bugs get_details omits. Pass includeSubtree to also dump children (#547).

list_bindings.summary: List designer property bindings on a WidgetBlueprint (the UE 5.7 Python API keeps them protected). Returns {widgetName, propertyName, functionName, bindingType}. Optional filterWidgetName/filterProperty (#530).

clear_binding.summary: Remove designer binding(s) matching widgetName (and optional propertyName) from a WidgetBlueprint without opening the editor. Idempotent (#530).

set_property.summary: Set widget property. Slot struct props take UE struct text that persists every field - `Slot.Size`=`(Value=1.0,SizeRule=Fill)`, `Slot.Padding`=`(Left=8,Top=8,Right=8,Bottom=8)` - or a nested field path like `Slot.Size.Value` / `Slot.Padding.Left`; an invalid value errors instead of silently writing 0 (#532). value may also be a JSON object or array, filled field by field (`Slot.Padding`={Left:8,Top:8,Right:8,Bottom:8}). An enum takes `Bottom`, `VAlign_Bottom`, `EVerticalAlignment::VAlign_Bottom` or an enumerator number; any other value is refused (#1540).

set_style.summary: Set a full/nested style struct on a widget from JSON (FButtonStyle, FEditableTextBoxStyle, FSlateFontInfo, FSlateColor and their nested brushes) - what set_property's scalar path can't express. value is a JSON object mirroring the struct; propertyName is the struct property, e.g. WidgetStyle (#563).

reorder_child.summary: Reorder a widget among its parent panel's children (move to a sibling index) - e.g. insert a new row BETWEEN two existing children. move_widget only reparents (#635).

bulk_set_properties.summary: Apply many {widgetName, propertyName, value} style/property writes to a WidgetBlueprint in one call (single compile+save) - font/color/style stylesheet across many widgets (#563). propertyName takes the same paths as set_widget_property: slot.* (any case) on the widget's slot, dotted paths into structs, and its typed names; value is JSON (an object or array fills a struct or array, a string may be UE struct text). Each entry reports its own ok/error, and the rollback replays the previous values through this action (#1632).

list.summary: List Widget BPs, sorted by object path.

create_animation.summary: Create a UMG animation on a Widget Blueprint, with its MovieScene, display rate and playback range. Idempotent by animationName: a second call reports existed and leaves the timing alone.

delete_animation.summary: Delete a UMG animation from a Widget Blueprint, including its bindings. The rollback recreates an empty animation of the same name and rate, so the tracks and keys are NOT restored.

get_animation.summary: Read one UMG animation in full: display rate, tick resolution, playback range, and per bound widget every track, section, channel and key time/value in SECONDS, plus the event tracks. read_animations reports the shape, this reports the values, which is what verifies a key actually landed.

add_animation_track.summary: Add a property track to a UMG animation, binding the widget into the animation first if it is not bound yet. The track class is chosen from the property's own reflected type; a property Sequencer cannot key is refused by name with the keyable types listed.

remove_animation_track.summary: Remove a property track from a UMG animation. The rollback re-adds the empty track, so its keys are NOT restored.

add_animation_key.summary: Set a key on an animation track channel at a time in SECONDS, creating the track and the section if needed. Pick the channel by name (R/G/B/A, Left/Top/Right/Bottom, Translation.X) or by channelIndex; a miss lists the channels the section actually has.

remove_animation_key.summary: Remove the key at a time in SECONDS from an animation track channel. Removing a key that is not there reports unchanged rather than failing.

add_animation_event_key.summary: Add an event key that calls a Widget Blueprint function at a time in SECONDS, creating the event track and its trigger section if needed. trackName defaults to Events.

remove_animation_event_key.summary: Remove the event key at a time in SECONDS from an animation event track.

bind_animation_event.summary: Bind an animation lifecycle event (Finished or Started) on a Widget Blueprint to a handler graph, creating the K2Node_WidgetAnimationEvent if it is not there. userTag scopes a Started binding. Idempotent: an existing binding reports existed.

unbind_animation_event.summary: Remove an animation lifecycle event binding from a Widget Blueprint.

set_navigation.summary: Write UMG navigation rules on a widget: rule is Escape, Explicit, Wrap, Stop, Custom or CustomBoundary, direction is Up, Down, Left, Right, Next or Previous, and widgetToFocus names the target for Explicit. Creates the UWidgetNavigation subobject that set_property cannot make. Pass one write as widgetName + direction + rule, or many as rules[] of {widgetName, direction, rule, widgetToFocus}; the whole batch is validated before anything is written.

clear_navigation.summary: Reset navigation rules on a widget back to Escape. Omit direction to clear all six. Clearing what is already clear reports unchanged.

restore_navigation.summary: Restore navigation rules from a captured snapshot - the `previous` array that set_navigation and clear_navigation put in their rollback payload, so a failed flow can be undone by hand as well as by the runner.

audit_focus_chain.summary: Read-only report over the whole widget tree: which widgets can take focus, their explicit navigation edges, widgets reachable from none of them, edges pointing at a missing/invisible/unfocusable target, and directions whose opposite does not lead back.

audit_accessibility.summary: Read-only accessibility report over the whole widget tree: font sizes under minFontSize, interactive widgets whose authored hit area is under minHitSize, and what could not be checked from authored values alone.

get_runtime_focus_path.summary: Read the live Slate focus path for a user index in PIE - which widget holds focus and the chain of widgets above it. Requires a running PIE or Game world; the editor's own focus is never reported.

set_runtime_focus.summary: Give keyboard focus to a named child of a live PIE widget, so a navigation chain can be walked and verified rather than predicted. Locate the host with className when more than one instance is up. Setting focus where it already is reports unchanged.

create.summary: Create Widget BP. assetPath is the full destination, e.g. /Game/UI/WBP_Example; name + packagePath is the older spelling of the same thing. Idempotent by path.

create_utility_widget.summary: Create editor utility widget. assetPath is the full destination; name + packagePath is the older spelling. Idempotent by path.

create_utility_blueprint.summary: Create editor utility blueprint. assetPath is the full destination; name + packagePath is the older spelling. Idempotent by path.

add_widget.summary: Add widget to widget tree. Idempotent by assetPath + widgetName: passing widgetName makes a retry safe, and the result carries requestedWidgetName/persistedWidgetName/renamed plus compileStatus.

build_tree.summary: Build a nested widget subtree in one call (#1300). tree is one node {widgetClass, widgetName?, properties?, children?}, children nesting the same shape; properties take set_widget_property names, slot.* included, with JSON values (a string, number or bool goes through set_widget_property's routes, an object or array through the JSON setter). The whole spec is validated (classes, panels, unique and unused names) before anything is built, any failure undoes every widget it built, and the blueprint is compiled and saved once. Lands under parentWidgetName, else the root panel, else becomes the root. The one rollback is remove_widget on the subtree root, which removes everything under it. Wrap several siblings in a panel node.

remove_widget.summary: Remove widget from tree. Idempotent, and clears the widget's Widget Blueprint GUID metadata so later compiles stop reporting a deleted variable (#799).

rename_widget.summary: Rename a widget in place (#1679). It keeps its object, slot, sibling position and properties; the variable GUID, designer bindings, animation bindings, navigation rules, desired focus and graph get/set nodes move to the new name. Refuses a name another widget, variable or function holds, unless it is a BindWidget name on the native parent for a widget of the bound class, which is how a copied widget is fitted to a BindWidget contract. Reports referencesUpdated; idempotent by the new name; the rollback renames it back.

set_root.summary: Replace WBP root with an existing widget by name (#365).

wrap_root.summary: Wrap the current root in a new panel widget (UMG 'Wrap With'). wrapperClass must be a UPanelWidget subclass (#365).

list_classes.summary: List the UWidget classes this editor has loaded, grouped by the module that defines them, each with its full path, parent class, whether it is a panel that accepts children, and the slot properties its children take. This is how a CommonUI or project-C++ widget is discovered: pass a row's `name` to add_widget as widgetClass, or its `path` when two modules share a name. Loaded classes only, so a Widget Blueprint nothing has opened is absent (use list) and a class from a disabled plugin does not exist until project(enable_plugin) and a restart.

get_bind_widget_contract.summary: Report the BindWidget contract a native UserWidget parent imposes: every UPROPERTY marked BindWidget, BindWidgetOptional, BindWidgetAnim or BindWidgetAnimOptional, with the exact widget name it demands, the class that name must be, whether it is optional, and which ancestor declares it. Metadata is not a property value and reflect_class does not report these keys, so this is the only way to learn the contract short of a failed compile. Pass className for the contract alone, or assetPath to also check one Widget Blueprint's own tree against its parent and get back satisfied/missing/wrongType.

audit_commonui.summary: Read-only CommonUI wiring report. Checks the rules that fail silently at runtime rather than at compile time: the plugin being enabled at all, GameViewportClientClass being a CommonGameViewportClient (without it gamepad navigation and Back do nothing), CommonInputSettings.InputData being set (without it no input action resolves and bound action bars render empty) and, when assetPath names a Widget Blueprint, an activatable widget with no DesiredFocusWidget, a CommonBoundActionBar with no ActionButtonClass, and CommonUI widgets with no Style. Every problem carries the exact call that fixes it.

extract_subtree.summary: Lift an authored designer subtree out of one WidgetBlueprint into a standalone one, using UMG's own clipboard serializer so hierarchy, child order, editable properties, panel slot data and named-slot content survive. The selected widget becomes the destination root. dryRun defaults to true and only returns the name mapping - pass dryRun=false to actually write the asset. The destination must be absent or empty; an exact-shape replay returns existed. The source is never compiled or saved.

list_viewmodels.summary: List the viewmodels a Widget Blueprint declares: viewModelName, viewModelId, viewModelClass, creationType (Manual, CreateInstance, GlobalViewModelCollection, PropertyPath, Resolver, Context), the global identifier or property path it is fetched by, the optional/setter/getter flags and how many bindings use it. Needs the UMG Viewmodel plugin (ModelViewViewModel) enabled.

add_viewmodel.summary: Add a viewmodel to a Widget Blueprint. viewModelClass is a native MVVMViewModelBase subclass or a Blueprint viewmodel asset path; viewModelName defaults to the class name; creationType must be one the class allows, with globalViewModelIdentifier for GlobalViewModelCollection and viewModelPropertyPath for PropertyPath. Idempotent by viewModelName (same class reports existed). Saved, not compiled: run compile_viewmodels. The rollback removes it.

remove_viewmodel.summary: Remove a viewmodel from a Widget Blueprint by viewModelName. Bindings that use it are left in place and listed as bindingsLeftDangling. The rollback re-adds it with the same id, so those bindings resolve again. Removing one that is not there reports alreadyDeleted.

list_viewmodel_bindings.summary: List a Widget Blueprint's viewmodel bindings: bindingId, displayName, sourcePath and destinationPath (ViewModelName.Field, WidgetName.Property or Self.Member), bindingMode, executionMode (Default when not overridden), enabled, includeInCompile, the conversion function with its direction and arguments ({path} or {literal} per input), and the errors and warnings the last compile recorded on it. Every row is also valid add_viewmodel_binding input.

add_viewmodel_binding.summary: Add a viewmodel binding. Paths start with a viewmodel name, a widget name or Self and walk fields: sourcePath PlayerVM.Health to destinationPath HealthBar.Percent. bindingMode defaults to OneWayToDestination. conversionFunction (Class.Function, /Script/Module.Class:Function, or a function on the blueprint) converts the value; conversionArguments set its inputs by pin name to a literal or {path}, and sourcePath goes to the first input no argument names. Idempotent: the same destination, mode and source (or conversion) reports existed. Saved, not compiled. The rollback removes it.

update_viewmodel_binding.summary: Change an existing viewmodel binding by bindingId: any of sourcePath, destinationPath, bindingMode, executionMode (Default clears the override), conversionFunction (empty string removes it) with conversionArguments, enabled, includeInCompile. A call that changes nothing reports unchanged. The rollback restores the previous values.

remove_viewmodel_binding.summary: Remove a viewmodel binding by bindingId. The rollback re-adds it from its captured paths, mode, flags and conversion (under a new id). Removing one that is not there reports alreadyDeleted.

compile_viewmodels.summary: Compile a Widget Blueprint and report its viewmodel bindings with the errors and warnings the viewmodel compiler recorded on each (bindingErrorCount), plus compileStatus. Saved when the compile succeeds.

list_runtime.summary: (#160) List live UUserWidget instances in the PIE world, sorted by object path.

get_runtime.summary: (#160) Inspect a live PIE widget tree with text/visibility/brush/percent plus style values: renderOpacity (all), colorAndOpacity (TextBlock/Image), Border brushColor/contentColorAndOpacity (#592). includeLayout adds read-only layout diagnostics to every node - geometry (desired/local/absolute size, layout and render bounds), render transform, effective opacity, reflected slot properties including structured Canvas anchors/offsets/alignment, derived clipping, parent and viewport overlap, and a diagnostics array - plus the host UserWidget node under `host`, a `layoutCapture` summary, and per-node `deltaSincePreviousCapture` against the previous includeLayout call on that instance, so capture / reproduce / capture again isolates position-dependent sizing. Off by default: it is a much larger payload. A given widgetName and className must both match.

inspect_runtime_instances.summary: Inspect every matching live widget instance (never an implicit first match), with stable identity/owning-player metadata and selected reflected properties on the widget or subtree. Requires a running PIE/Game world and errors instead of falling back to the editor world. Passing childName or childClassFilter implies includeSubtree. Provide widgetName or classFilter.

get_runtime_delegates.summary: (#161) Read delegate binding state on a live PIE widget, located by widgetName or className. Returns array of {delegateName, isBound, numBindings}.

add_to_viewport.summary: (#602) Instantiate a WidgetBlueprint and add it to the live PIE viewport for visual verification. Requires PIE running.

invoke_runtime_function.summary: (#559/#812) Fire a UI interaction on a live PIE widget: a parameterless UFUNCTION (functionName) on the located UserWidget, OR drive an interactive child via childName - Button (click), CheckBox (value true/false/toggle), Slider and SpinBox (numeric value), EditableText/EditableTextBox/MultiLineEditableText/MultiLineEditableTextBox (string value), ComboBoxString (option string or index), CommonButtonBase (click through its HandleButtonClicked; OnPressed/OnReleased via functionName). The matching delegate is broadcast so bound Blueprint logic runs. functionName alongside childName picks the delegate (e.g. OnPressed, OnTextChanged). Locate the widget with widgetName or className.

epic_activate_widget.summary: [Epic CommonUIToolset.CommonUIToolset] Activate a live activatable widget, as if the game had activated it. Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_add_uicomponent.summary: [Epic UMGToolSet.UMGToolSet] Adds a UI component of the given class to the named widget. On UE 5.9 it calls UMGEditor.WidgetBlueprintEditorSubsystem.AddUIComponent.

epic_add_view_condition.summary: [Epic MVVMToolset.MVVMToolset] Adds a condition to the WidgetBlueprint's View: when the source value changes and compares true against Value (Value to MaxValue for a Between operation), the destination is called or set. The widget blueprint is then compiled; compile errors do not fail the call and are reported in the condition's CompileErrors. Not supported during PIE. Values are compared as 32-bit floats. A destination function is called with default parameter values, and a destination property is set to its type's default value, not to the source value. Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_add_view_model_property.summary: [Epic MVVMToolset.MVVMToolset] Add a property to an existing ViewModel. The ViewModel is compiled automatically when it is next added to a widget or used in a binding. Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_add_view_model_to_widget.summary: [Epic MVVMToolset.MVVMToolset] Adds a ViewModel to the WidgetBlueprint Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_add_widget.summary: [Epic UMGToolSet.UMGToolSet] Adds a widget to the tree at the specified position. Returns full widget info including Slot pointer. When ParentWidget is null and no root exists, the new widget becomes the root of the tree. Use ObjectTools.list_properties on the returned Widget and Slot to get property names before calling set_properties. Available on UE 5.8; absent from UE 5.9.

epic_add_widget_to_animation.summary: [Epic WidgetAnimationToolset.WidgetAnimationToolset] Add a UWidget (or a UPanelSlot with non-null content) as a possessable binding on a widget animation. Returns a FMovieSceneBindingProxy usable with every SequencerScripting method that takes a binding (MovieSceneBindingExtensions.AddTrack, etc.). ObjectToBind must be either: - A UWidget inside the Widget Blueprint's tree (typical case: animate a child widget's properties). - A UPanelSlot whose Content is non-null (animate slot properties like padding/anchors). The Widget Blueprint must have a compiled GeneratedClass. The implementation compiles the blueprint if needed before binding. Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_analog_input.summary: [Epic SlateInspectorToolset.SlateInspectorToolset] Send an analog axis value along the target user's focus path; 1D axes only, send 0 afterwards to release. Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_bind_to_event_property.summary: [Epic UMGToolSet.UMGToolSet] Adds a Blueprint event handler graph node bound to a widget's multicast delegate event, Typical events: UButton::OnClicked / OnPressed / OnReleased / OnHovered / OnUnhovered, UCheckBox::OnCheckStateChanged, USlider::OnValueChanged. The matching delegate UPROPERTY must exist on PropertyClass (or a parent of it). Preconditions: - PropertyName must exist in the blueprint. - PropertyClass must be the widget's class (or a parent class) that declares the delegate. On UE 5.9 it calls UMGEditor.WidgetBlueprintEditorSubsystem.BindToEventProperty.

epic_clear_conversion_function_argument_.summary: [Epic MVVMToolset.MVVMToolset] Removes the property path bound to an input pin of a binding's conversion function, resetting the pin to its default literal, then recompiles the WidgetBlueprint. The compiler does not warn if the cleared pin carried the binding's source value. If the recompile fails the edit is kept; use CompileWidgetBlueprint to read the errors. Not supported during PIE. Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_clear_focus_log.summary: [Epic SlateDebugger.SlateDebuggerSubsystem] Clears all recorded events. Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_clear_highlight.summary: [Epic WidgetFinder.WidgetFinderSubsystem] Remove any highlight overlay drawn by Highlight. Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_clear_widget_lifetime_log.summary: [Epic UMGEditor.UMGDebuggerSubsystem] Discards all captured events. Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_click.summary: [Epic SlateInspectorToolset.SlateInspectorToolset] Click a Slate widget identified by its ref. Returns false without clicking when the target point would not receive the event -- something is on top of it, the widget has no arranged size, or MouseDown still holds the button. The log and LastRefusal() name the reason. True means the event was delivered to the widget's branch, not that the widget handled it.

epic_compile_widget_blueprint.summary: [Epic UMGToolSet.UMGToolSet] Compiles a widget blueprint. Returns false with error details if compilation fails. Errors include missing BindWidget bindings, type mismatches, and graph errors. Call after all widgets and properties are set. Save separately via AssetTools.save_asset. On UE 5.9 it calls UMGEditor.WidgetBlueprintEditorSubsystem.CompileWidgetBlueprint.

epic_create_and_add_widget.summary: [Epic UMGEditor.WidgetBlueprintEditorSubsystem] Adds a widget to the tree at the specified position. When ParentWidget is null and no root exists, the new widget becomes the root of the tree. Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_create_view_binding.summary: [Epic MVVMToolset.MVVMToolset] Creates a View Binding from the SourceProperty to the Destination property. If ConversionName is given, that conversion function is used, even if the property types already match (e.g. to format a FText). Otherwise, if there is a type mismatch, an existing conversion function will try to be used. Property paths resolve against each segment's declared type, so a field that only exists on a subclass of an intermediate object's declared type won't resolve. Bind to the intermediate object and cast inside a conversion function instead. Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_create_view_event_binding.summary: [Epic MVVMToolset.MVVMToolset] Creates a View Event Binding from the EventProperty to the Destination property. Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_create_view_model.summary: [Epic MVVMToolset.MVVMToolset] Creates a new ViewModel asset Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_create_widget_animation.summary: [Epic WidgetAnimationToolset.WidgetAnimationToolset] Create a new UWidgetAnimation on a Widget Blueprint and return its summary. The empty FWidgetAnimationInfo return signals failure (Animation == nullptr). Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_create_widget_blueprint.summary: [Epic UMGToolSet.UMGToolSet] Creates a new Widget Blueprint asset. Returns the blueprint or nullptr on failure. On UE 5.9 it calls UMGEditor.WidgetBlueprintEditorSubsystem.CreateWidgetBlueprint.

epic_deactivate_widget.summary: [Epic CommonUIToolset.CommonUIToolset] Deactivate a live activatable widget. Same addressing rules as ActivateWidget, but matches only currently-active widgets. Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_describe_widget.summary: [Epic WidgetStaticAnalysisToolset.WidgetStaticAnalysisToolset] Full structured description of every widget in the tree (or the subtree rooted at StartWidget). Values are the designer-time state stored in the asset. Anything set at runtime (for example a Blueprint graph changing a slot through SlotAsCanvasSlot, or style state that is not a UPROPERTY) does not appear; use TraceWidgetPropertyOverrides for graph writes. ComposedColors reports the composed pre-display **linear** tint only -- never a display-space value, and never for URichTextBlock/CommonRichTextBlock (a fundamentally different per-inline-tag-run model, excluded from v1 coverage). It does not model the contrast setting, DisplayGamma, retainer boxes, Button's DisabledEffect, or widget animations. Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_drag.summary: [Epic SlateInspectorToolset.SlateInspectorToolset] Drag from one Slate widget to another (mouse down, stepped move, release). Both ends are hit-tested first; returns false without dragging if either is covered or unarranged. The pointer is stepped along the path, so drag detection fires partway and the target receives OnDragOver, including once at the drop point. Waypoints bend that path, for gestures a straight line would not produce. Start and end positions are normalized within each widget and default to the center. Use them to aim at edge-band drop zones, e.g. EndPosition.Y = 0.1 to drop against the target's top edge. Leave EndRef empty and pass MoveBy or Waypoints to drag StartRef by a distance instead of onto another widget, e.g. splitters, sliders, scrollbars and divider grips. EndPosition is then ignored, and a path that never leaves the press point is refused since the drag would not move.

epic_fill_form.summary: [Epic SlateInspectorToolset.SlateInspectorToolset] Fill multiple Slate form fields at once.

epic_find_widget_animation.summary: [Epic WidgetAnimationToolset.WidgetAnimationToolset] Find an animation by internal name. Returns empty info (Animation == nullptr) when not found. Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_fixup_mvvmdata.summary: [Epic MVVMToolset.MVVMToolset] Attempts to fixup MVVM data. This function can be called if the MVVM Generated Blueprint graphs like conversion functions report compilation errors. It regenerates the graphs to ensure parity with view binding data. Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_focus.summary: [Epic SlateInspectorToolset.SlateInspectorToolset] Set Slate keyboard/navigation focus to a widget, e.g. before gamepad navigation in PIE. Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_get_action_bindings.summary: [Epic CommonUIToolset.CommonUIToolset] All UI action bindings currently active (reachable by input) for a player. Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_get_activatable_tree.summary: [Epic CommonUIToolset.CommonUIToolset] Snapshot of the CommonUI activatable tree: root nodes, action-domain roots with children and bindings, active root, leafmost active widget, and optionally the full-depth indented tree dump text. Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_get_container_widget_navigation_doc.summary: [Epic UMGEditor.WidgetBlueprintEditorSubsystem] Returns navigation/focus documentation for a container widget class - both layout panels (UScrollBox, UVerticalBox, ...) and list views (UListView, UTileView, ...). Reads from the class's Navigation* UCLASS meta and its ancestors', so it needs only a class, not a widget instance. Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_get_current_focus.summary: [Epic SlateDebugger.SlateDebuggerSubsystem] What has focus RIGHT NOW for a user, queried live from Slate, with its full widget path. Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_get_event_logging_status.summary: [Epic CommonUIToolset.CommonUIToolset] The current status of the logger: on/off, event count, dropped count, time span, subscribed players. Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_get_event_timeline.summary: [Epic CommonUIToolset.CommonUIToolset] Chronological digest of logged events, oldest first. Never carries callstacks; use GetLoggedEvents when those are wanted. Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_get_focus_event_detail.summary: [Epic SlateDebugger.SlateDebuggerSubsystem] The full causal chain for ONE event, located precisely by its sequence number (from any GetFocusEvents/GetFocusTimeline row). FocusReceived -> full path + symbolicated callstack + context + linked input/nav; other event types -> that record bare. bFound=false if evicted. Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_get_focus_events.summary: [Epic SlateDebugger.SlateDebuggerSubsystem] Recent events (newest first), filtered. Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_get_focus_log_status.summary: [Epic SlateDebugger.SlateDebuggerSubsystem] Recording status: on/off, record count, dropped count, time span. Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_get_focus_state.summary: [Epic CommonUIToolset.CommonUIToolset] Where Slate focus actually is for a player and where CommonUI intends it to be: the focused Slate widget, its UMG and owning-activatable identity, the leafmost widget's desired focus target, and whether focus sits inside the active root and the leafmost hierarchy. Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_get_focus_timeline.summary: [Epic SlateDebugger.SlateDebuggerSubsystem] Lightweight chronological digest of recorded events (oldest->newest). No paths/callstack. Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_get_input_routing_state.summary: [Epic CommonUIToolset.CommonUIToolset] Everything governing whether input reaches game vs UI for a player: active input mode and config (mouse capture/lock, move/look ignore), the viewport and player controller flags that can block input regardless of CommonUI state, current input device type, input type locks, held keys, leafmost widget, and current Slate focus. Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_get_logged_events.summary: [Epic CommonUIToolset.CommonUIToolset] Logged events, filtered. Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_get_named_slots.summary: [Epic UMGToolSet.UMGToolSet] Returns named slot bindings (separate from tree hierarchy). On UE 5.9 it calls UMGEditor.WidgetBlueprintEditorSubsystem.GetNamedSlots.

epic_get_query_syntax.summary: [Epic WidgetFinder.WidgetFinderSubsystem] Retrieve the complete query grammar, so a Query can be built without guessing. Works with the service stopped. Call this first when unsure of the syntax. The response's Description carries the signature-token legend. Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_get_service_status.summary: [Epic WidgetFinder.WidgetFinderSubsystem] Read the service state without changing it, to check it is up or that a start stored something. Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_get_umginfo.summary: [Epic SlateInspectorToolset.SlateInspectorToolset] Resolve a Slate widget ref back to the UMG UWidget that created it (for UMG and PIE UIs). Returns the UWidget name, its UClass, the owning WidgetBlueprint asset path, the enclosing UUserWidget chain, and a live Widget handle. "resolvedVia" is "self" when the widget itself carries UMG metadata, or "parent" when an ancestor did. On failure Error is set and Widget is null: either the widget is pure Slate with no UMG owner, or its authoring UWidget has since been destroyed. The remaining metadata fields are still filled in for the latter case. Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_get_view_model_connection_map.summary: [Epic WidgetStaticAnalysisToolset.WidgetStaticAnalysisToolset] Reverse-searches every Widget Blueprint whose MVVM View references ViewModelClass, and returns each one's own connection map grouped per widget. Each widget's rows are narrowed to just the VMFieldBinding bindings to that exact ViewModelClass; call GetWidgetConnectionMap directly for a widget's whole map. Native (non-Blueprint) ViewModel classes never surface here, since they have no on-disk package identity for the reverse search to find. Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_get_widget_animation_bindings.summary: [Epic WidgetAnimationToolset.WidgetAnimationToolset] Get all bindings on a widget animation as FMovieSceneBindingProxy entries. Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_get_widget_class_info.summary: [Epic UMGToolSet.UMGToolSet] Returns the Category, Description and if it's a Panel for a single widget class. Same per-entry data as ListWidgetClasses, but lets callers query a class they already have without scanning every UClass. Returns an empty entry if WidgetClass is null. Can be used to get more information on the class from the Description and Category. On UE 5.9 it calls UMGEditor.WidgetBlueprintEditorSubsystem.GetWidgetClassInfo.

epic_get_widget_connection_map.summary: [Epic WidgetStaticAnalysisToolset.WidgetStaticAnalysisToolset] Maps every connection on WidgetBlueprint (MVVM field bindings, event bindings, delegates, and legacy property bindings) into one pre-sorted checklist, Unconnected/Misconfigured rows first. Misconfigured only applies to VMFieldBinding rows: Fixable if a conversion function can bridge the types, Unbridgeable if none is allowlisted. Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_get_widget_description.summary: [Epic UMGToolSet.UMGToolSet] Full property dump of every widget in the tree. Each line: [N] Type Name Prop:Value ... slot:(SlotProp:Value ...) N is the 0-based index into result.Widgets -- use result.Widgets[N] to get the widget ref without text parsing. Same indentation format as GetTaggedWidgetDescription; richer per-widget detail. Available on UE 5.8; absent from UE 5.9.

epic_get_widget_lifetime_events.summary: [Epic UMGEditor.UMGDebuggerSubsystem] Returns captured widget lifetime events, newest first. Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_get_widget_lifetime_log_status.summary: [Epic UMGEditor.UMGDebuggerSubsystem] Returns whether recording is running plus how many events are held and were dropped. Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_get_widget_preview_active.summary: [Epic MVVMToolset.MVVMToolset] Reads the View Bindings design-time preview toggle state for a WidgetBlueprint. Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_get_widget_tree_depth.summary: [Epic UMGToolSet.UMGToolSet] Returns the maximum depth of the widget tree. Depth: root with no children = 0; root + children = 1; etc. Available on UE 5.8; absent from UE 5.9.

epic_get_widget_tree_depth__widget_stati.summary: [Epic WidgetStaticAnalysisToolset.WidgetStaticAnalysisToolset] Returns the maximum depth of the widget tree. Depth: root with no children = 0; root + children = 1; etc. Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_get_widget_view_config.summary: [Epic MVVMToolset.MVVMToolset] Returns the MVVM View configuration. Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_get_widgets.summary: [Epic UMGToolSet.UMGToolSet] Returns blueprint info and all widgets in depth-first order. Children within each parent are in their panel slot order - this is the hierarchy order shown in the designer. Info contains ParentClass (pass to CreateWidgetBlueprint) and RootWidgetClass. Use ObjectTools.list_properties on each returned Widget and Slot to get property names before calling set_properties. On UE 5.9 it calls UMGEditor.WidgetBlueprintEditorSubsystem.GetWidgets.

epic_highlight.summary: [Epic WidgetFinder.WidgetFinderSubsystem] Outline every match in the live UI with the Widget Reflector's debug border, to see what a query selects. Needs a running service. Replaces any current highlight and persists until ClearHighlight or an empty query. Detached matches count in TotalMatchCount but only draw once their tab or window is surfaced. Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_hit_test.summary: [Epic SlateInspectorToolset.SlateInspectorToolset] Report whether a widget is reachable by pointer input, without changing anything. Returns JSON {reached, samples, reachedSamples, x, y, reason}, using the same hit test Click, Hover, Drag and Scroll refuse on; `reason` names the obstruction. Grid > 1 samples a Grid x Grid lattice inset inside the widget instead of a single point. `reachedSamples` counts the samples that hit, and x/y locate the first sample that missed. Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_hover.summary: [Epic SlateInspectorToolset.SlateInspectorToolset] Hover over a Slate widget, triggering any hover state or tooltip. Returns false without hovering when the target point is covered or the widget is unarranged. Unlike the other action tools, Hover moves the OS cursor, since hover state only lasts while the pointer stays over the widget. On Mac, Click, Drag and Scroll move it too and leave it on the target, because Mac only routes pointer input to the window under the real cursor. A button held by MouseDown stays held.

epic_key_down.summary: [Epic SlateInspectorToolset.SlateInspectorToolset] Press a key and leave it held; pair with KeyUp. Same key specs and gamepad routing as PressKey. A held modifier key (LeftShift, RightControl, LeftAlt, LeftCommand, ...) is down for every later key event of the same Slate user until released, by KeyUp or by a PressKey of the same key. It does not apply to pointer tools, which take their own Modifiers, nor to the platform modifier state FSlateApplication::GetModifierKeys reports. KeyUp or ReleaseHeldInput releases it, as does the hold watchdog after SlateInspectorToolset.HeldInputTimeoutSeconds without a pointer, touch, KeyDown or KeyUp call. Returns true once the press is sent, whether or not a widget handled it, as a held modifier is normally unhandled. False means nothing was sent because the key or user is invalid; LastRefusal() names the reason. Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_key_up.summary: [Epic SlateInspectorToolset.SlateInspectorToolset] Release a key held by an earlier KeyDown for the same Slate user. Same key specs and gamepad routing as PressKey. Returns true once the release is sent, whether or not a widget handled it, as most widgets act on the press. False means nothing was sent because the key or user is invalid; LastRefusal() names the reason. Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_last_refusal.summary: [Epic SlateInspectorToolset.SlateInspectorToolset] Why the last action tool refused, as JSON {seq, tool, target, reason}; seq is 0 when nothing has refused this session. seq increments on each refusal, so sample it before an action and compare afterwards to tell a new refusal from one already read. Click, Hover, Scroll, Drag, Type, Focus, SelectOption, PressKey, KeyDown and KeyUp record refusals, and they record one every time they return false unless Slate is not running. For PressKey that includes a key that was sent but that nothing handled. Read-only tools such as Snapshot and HitTest never change it. Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_list_bindable_widget_properties.summary: [Epic MVVMToolset.MVVMToolset] Lists the bindable property paths available on a widget (binding source/destination candidates). Names aren't filtered by direction -- a read-only property can't be used as a destination and a write-only one can't be used as a source; CreateViewBinding reports that mismatch if it's tried. Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_list_binding_conversion_options.summary: [Epic MVVMToolset.MVVMToolset] Reports whether SourcePropertyPath and DestinationPropertyPath bind directly, and/or which conversion functions bridge them. Parameters mirror CreateViewBinding's Source-/Destination-prefixed parameters. A function-backed leaf field on either side resolves as unbridgeable. Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_list_class_bindable_fields.summary: [Epic MVVMToolset.MVVMToolset] Lists every field on TargetClass valid as an MVVM binding source or destination. Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_list_conversion_functions.summary: [Epic MVVMToolset.MVVMToolset] List Available Conversion functions for a WidgetBlueprint that bind a Source Property to a Destination Property Includes Pure and Const functions on the WidgetBlueprint itself once it has been compiled. Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_list_observers.summary: [Epic SlateInspectorToolset.SlateInspectorToolset] List all active observers as a JSON array for debugging. Each entry includes the observer identifier, whether it is the root observer, the root widget ref (if any), max depth, and cached snapshot size.

epic_list_property_path_bindable_fields.summary: [Epic MVVMToolset.MVVMToolset] Resolves PropertyPath against Context and describes that single field. Unlike ListClassBindableFields, this doesn't gate on private/protected -- CreateViewBinding can bind those fields too, so we don't hide them. bIsPrivate/bIsProtected on the result say which case it is. Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_list_view_conditions.summary: [Epic MVVMToolset.MVVMToolset] List all conditions on the WidgetBlueprint's View. Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_list_view_models.summary: [Epic MVVMToolset.MVVMToolset] List all ViewModel under the search path Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_list_widget_animations.summary: [Epic WidgetAnimationToolset.WidgetAnimationToolset] List all animations on a Widget Blueprint. Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_list_widget_blueprints.summary: [Epic UMGToolSet.UMGToolSet] Lists widget blueprints in a content folder. On UE 5.9 it calls UMGEditor.WidgetBlueprintEditorSubsystem.ListWidgetBlueprints.

epic_list_widget_classes.summary: [Epic UMGToolSet.UMGToolSet] Lists available widget classes, optionally filtered by name substring. On UE 5.9 it calls UMGEditor.WidgetBlueprintEditorSubsystem.ListWidgetClasses.

epic_list_widget_view_bindings.summary: [Epic MVVMToolset.MVVMToolset] List all view bindings on the WidgetBlueprint (including possible conversion functions). Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_list_widget_view_event_bindings.summary: [Epic MVVMToolset.MVVMToolset] List all event bindings currently configured on the WidgetBlueprint's View, along with their context information. Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_list_widget_view_events.summary: [Epic MVVMToolset.MVVMToolset] List Available Event Properties for a WidgetBlueprint (i.e. a Multicast Delegate) Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_list_widget_view_models.summary: [Epic MVVMToolset.MVVMToolset] List all view models used by a widget Blueprint Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_mouse_down.summary: [Epic SlateInspectorToolset.SlateInspectorToolset] Press a mouse button at a widget's center and leave it held; idempotent for a button this widget already holds. MouseUp or ReleaseHeldInput releases it, as does the hold watchdog after SlateInspectorToolset.HeldInputTimeoutSeconds without a pointer, touch, KeyDown or KeyUp call. Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_mouse_move.summary: [Epic SlateInspectorToolset.SlateInspectorToolset] Move the pointer to an absolute screen position; a button held by MouseDown stays held, so MouseDown/MouseMove/MouseUp drags. Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_mouse_move_to.summary: [Epic SlateInspectorToolset.SlateInspectorToolset] Move the pointer to a widget's center plus an offset; a held button stays held. Use MouseMove for an absolute position. Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_mouse_up.summary: [Epic SlateInspectorToolset.SlateInspectorToolset] Release a mouse button at the pointer, to its captor or whatever lies under it; safe without a prior MouseDown. Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_move_uicomponent.summary: [Epic UMGToolSet.UMGToolSet] Moves a UI component before or after another component on the same widget. On UE 5.9 it calls UMGEditor.WidgetBlueprintEditorSubsystem.MoveUIComponent.

epic_move_widget.summary: [Epic UMGToolSet.UMGToolSet] Moves a widget to a new parent panel at the specified position. Returns updated widget info with new Slot. On UE 5.9 it calls UMGEditor.WidgetBlueprintEditorSubsystem.MoveWidget.

epic_observe.summary: [Epic SlateInspectorToolset.SlateInspectorToolset] Register an observer on a widget subtree so its refs are continuously kept up to date (~100ms tick). Call this on the window or panel you are about to work with. It ensures new widgets appearing in that subtree are assigned refs automatically. Unobserve when you are done. A shallow root observer (depth 0) already covers top-level windows.

epic_press_key.summary: [Epic SlateInspectorToolset.SlateInspectorToolset] Press and release a key on the focused Slate widget; gamepad keys route as controller input for the target user. Modifier keys held by KeyDown are down for the press, as with "Ctrl+" prefixes. True means some handler consumed the press, an auto-repeat, its char event or the release, not that the UI changed as intended. Any focusable widget handles Tab, arrow and D-pad keys as a navigation request, so true for them does not mean focus moved; compare Snapshot or HitTest before and after. False means nothing handled the key, or that nothing was sent because the key, user or RepeatCount is invalid; LastRefusal() names the reason, including which widget had focus. In PIE, false can also mean the game viewport passed the key to the game and the game did not consume it. Only BackSpace, Tab, Enter and Escape send a character; use Type to enter text.

epic_query.summary: [Epic WidgetFinder.WidgetFinderSubsystem] Locate live Slate widgets with a query, whose grammar GetQuerySyntax returns. Needs a running service. Check bSuccess and ErrorMessage first, since a syntax error also returns no matches. TotalMatchCount and bResultTruncated tell an under-constrained query from an exact one. Pass each result's `Ref` to the SlateInspectorToolset tools to act on the widget. Prefer Query and WaitForQuery over the SlateInspectorToolset Snapshot/Observe/Screenshot tools. Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_read_preview_widget_property.summary: [Epic MVVMToolset.MVVMToolset] Exports a property value from the live design-time preview widget of an open WidgetBlueprint designer. Use after SetWidgetPreviewActive to assert what the binding preview wrote to the canvas. Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_reconstruct_focus_path.summary: [Epic SlateDebugger.SlateDebuggerSubsystem] Reconstructs the causal chain (input -> navigation -> focus + context + callstack) that gave a widget focus. Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_refresh_active_root_focus.summary: [Epic CommonUIToolset.CommonUIToolset] Ask the router to re-apply focus to the active root's desired focus target. Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_release_held_input.summary: [Epic SlateInspectorToolset.SlateInspectorToolset] Release every button MouseDown still holds, lift every finger TouchStart still holds and release every key KeyDown still holds, returning how many; buttons the user holds are left alone. Also run by the hold watchdog after SlateInspectorToolset.HeldInputTimeoutSeconds (default 100) without a pointer, touch, KeyDown or KeyUp call, at PIE end and at shutdown. Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_remove_input_type_lock.summary: [Epic CommonUIToolset.CommonUIToolset] Remove an input type lock previously added with SetInputTypeLock. Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_remove_uicomponent.summary: [Epic UMGToolSet.UMGToolSet] Removes a UI component of the given class from the named widget. On UE 5.9 it calls UMGEditor.WidgetBlueprintEditorSubsystem.RemoveUIComponent.

epic_remove_view_condition.summary: [Epic MVVMToolset.MVVMToolset] Removes a condition from the WidgetBlueprint's View. Not supported during PIE. Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_remove_widget.summary: [Epic UMGToolSet.UMGToolSet] Removes a widget and its children from the tree. On UE 5.9 it calls UMGEditor.WidgetBlueprintEditorSubsystem.RemoveWidget.

epic_remove_widget_animation.summary: [Epic WidgetAnimationToolset.WidgetAnimationToolset] Remove an animation from a Widget Blueprint. Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_remove_widget_binding.summary: [Epic WidgetAnimationToolset.WidgetAnimationToolset] Remove a binding (by GUID) from a widget animation. Removes both the MovieScene possessable and the UMG binding entry. Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_remove_widget_view_binding.summary: [Epic MVVMToolset.MVVMToolset] Removes View Binding on the WidgetBlueprint Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_rename_widget.summary: [Epic UMGToolSet.UMGToolSet] Renames a widget. Returns updated widget info or empty on failure. On UE 5.9 it calls UMGEditor.WidgetBlueprintEditorSubsystem.RenameWidget.

epic_rename_widget_animation.summary: [Epic WidgetAnimationToolset.WidgetAnimationToolset] Rename an animation. NewName must not collide with an existing animation on the blueprint. Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_replace_widget_with_child.summary: [Epic UMGToolSet.UMGToolSet] Replaces a panel widget with its first child, removing the panel from the tree. The widget to replace must be a UPanelWidget with only one child. On UE 5.9 it calls UMGEditor.WidgetBlueprintEditorSubsystem.ReplaceWidgetWithChild.

epic_replace_widget_with_named_slot.summary: [Epic UMGToolSet.UMGToolSet] Replaces a host widget with the content of one of its named slots. The host must implement INamedSlotInterface (e.g., a UUserWidget exposing named slots). The slot's content widget is moved up to take the host's place in the tree. On UE 5.9 it calls UMGEditor.WidgetBlueprintEditorSubsystem.ReplaceWidgetWithNamedSlot.

epic_replace_widget_with_template.summary: [Epic UMGToolSet.UMGToolSet] Replaces a widget instance in the blueprint's widget tree with a new instance created from a different template widget class. Preserves references for members that exist on both classes with a compatible type/signature: bindings, BP graph variable references, animation bindings, and delegate bindings. Members without a compatible counterpart on the new class are listed in the returned report; references to those members in the outer blueprint will become orphaned graph nodes / dangling bindings. On UE 5.9 it calls UMGEditor.WidgetBlueprintEditorSubsystem.ReplaceWidgetWithTemplate.

epic_screenshot.summary: [Epic SlateInspectorToolset.SlateInspectorToolset] Screenshot a Slate widget or an editor window. Prefer this over SceneTools.take_screenshot for Editor UI; use SceneTools only for 3D viewport. Pass a window ref from Windows("list") to capture a specific window; with no ref it captures the active window, falling back to the main editor window when nothing is active. A widget partly outside its window is cropped to the part inside it. Fails with an error naming the reason when there is nothing to capture: an unknown ref, a widget in no visible window, or one entirely outside it.

epic_scroll.summary: [Epic SlateInspectorToolset.SlateInspectorToolset] Scroll the mouse wheel over a Slate widget. Hit-tested like Click; returns false without scrolling if the point is covered or unarranged. Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_select_option.summary: [Epic SlateInspectorToolset.SlateInspectorToolset] Select an option in a Slate combobox by its text label. Opens the dropdown, finds the matching text, and clicks it.

epic_set_binding_mode.summary: [Epic MVVMToolset.MVVMToolset] Sets the binding mode (OneTimeToDestination/OneWayToDestination/TwoWay/OneWayToSource) for an existing view binding. Not supported during PIE. Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_set_conversion_function_argument_li.summary: [Epic MVVMToolset.MVVMToolset] Sets a literal value on an input pin of a binding's conversion function, then recompiles the WidgetBlueprint. A pin bound to a property path must be cleared first with ClearConversionFunctionArgumentPath. If the recompile fails the value is kept; use CompileWidgetBlueprint to read the errors. Not supported during PIE. Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_set_event_binding_argument_literal.summary: [Epic MVVMToolset.MVVMToolset] Sets a literal value on an input pin of an event binding, then recompiles the WidgetBlueprint if the edit changed it. A pin bound to a property path is refused. If the recompile fails the value is kept; use CompileWidgetBlueprint to read the errors. Not supported during PIE. Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_set_input_type_lock.summary: [Epic CommonUIToolset.CommonUIToolset] Lock the effective input type for a player until the lock is removed. Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_set_named_slot_content.summary: [Epic UMGToolSet.UMGToolSet] Sets content for a named slot. Returns full widget info including Slot pointer. On UE 5.9 it calls UMGEditor.WidgetBlueprintEditorSubsystem.SetNamedSlotContent.

epic_set_tree_visualization.summary: [Epic CommonUIToolset.CommonUIToolset] Toggle an in-viewport overlay that outlines activatable widgets, color-coded by activation/focus state: green bold with a black halo = leafmost active node, green dashed = activated in the active-root chain, yellow dashed = activated outside the active root, dim grey = deactivated (only with bIncludeInactive), cyan = the leafmost widget's desired focus target, orange = the widget actually holding Slate focus, white dashed = active root boundary. Outlines are stacked by Slate paint layer, so the widget CommonUI treats as topmost is drawn on top. Each activatable's label ends in [ActivationFocus] or [NoActivationFocus]; labels of widgets that opt out of activation focus are drawn in magenta. A legend with the active input mode and type is drawn top-left. The overlay is hit-test-invisible, so it does not perturb the input being debugged; it is PIE-only and auto-disables on PIE end. A multi-client session gets one overlay per client window, each showing only the players that window owns. Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_set_view_condition_operation.summary: [Epic MVVMToolset.MVVMToolset] Sets the comparison of an existing condition, then compiles the widget blueprint; compile errors do not fail the call and are reported in the condition's CompileErrors. Not supported during PIE. Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_set_widget_animation_display_label.summary: [Epic WidgetAnimationToolset.WidgetAnimationToolset] Set the user-facing display label shown in the Animations panel. Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_set_widget_animation_length.summary: [Epic WidgetAnimationToolset.WidgetAnimationToolset] Set the animation playback length in seconds. Updates the MovieScene playback range to [0, LengthSeconds] in tick resolution. LengthSeconds must be > 0. Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_set_widget_preview_active.summary: [Epic MVVMToolset.MVVMToolset] Turns the View Bindings design-time preview on or off for a WidgetBlueprint, exactly like the eye toggle on the View Bindings panel toolbar. The WidgetBlueprint's designer must be open for the canvas to update; the state is stored either way. No-ops while the per-user Enable Design-Time View Model Preview editor preference is off. Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_set_widget_view_binding_enabled.summary: [Epic MVVMToolset.MVVMToolset] Changes the enabled and compile flag for an existing widget view binding. Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_set_widget_view_config.summary: [Epic MVVMToolset.MVVMToolset] Writes the MVVM View configuration on the WidgetBlueprint's View. Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_show_widget_lifetime_log_window.summary: [Epic UMGEditor.UMGDebuggerSubsystem] Opens or focuses the Widget Lifetime Log editor tab, which shows the same recording. Returns false without a Slate UI. Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_snapshot.summary: [Epic SlateInspectorToolset.SlateInspectorToolset] Capture a Slate UI accessibility snapshot. Use this to read the current widget tree and discover refs for action tools (Click, Type, Hover, etc.). A shallow root observer (depth 0) covers top-level windows automatically. Before interacting with a specific window or panel, call Observe() on it to get deep coverage, then Snapshot that subtree to see its contents. Refs discovered by a previous Snapshot remain usable. You do NOT need to call Snapshot again before every action. Each [pos=X,Y size=W,H] is the widget's on-screen bounds in desktop pixels, whatever the DPI scale or rotation, the same space as the pointer and touch tools' screen positions and offsets.

epic_start_event_logging.summary: [Epic CommonUIToolset.CommonUIToolset] Begin logging CommonUI events (widget activation/deactivation/rebuild, input mode/config changes, input method changes, container displayed-widget/transition changes) into an in-memory ring buffer. Restarting clears the buffer. Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_start_focus_recording.summary: [Epic SlateDebugger.SlateDebuggerSubsystem] Starts recording Slate focus and navigation events into an in-memory buffer, discarding events already captured. Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_start_service.summary: [Epic WidgetFinder.WidgetFinderSubsystem] Begin mirroring the live Slate widget tree into the store, so Query/Highlight/WaitForQuery can work. The service is off by default. Call this once before locating widgets and leave it running for the session. Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_start_widget_lifetime_logging.summary: [Epic UMGEditor.UMGDebuggerSubsystem] Starts recording Constructed, Destructed and Rebuilt events for every user widget, discarding events already captured. Query them with GetWidgetLifetimeEvents. Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_stop_event_logging.summary: [Epic CommonUIToolset.CommonUIToolset] Stop logging; the buffer is retained for querying. Does nothing when not logging. Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_stop_focus_recording.summary: [Epic SlateDebugger.SlateDebuggerSubsystem] Stops recording. The buffer is retained for querying. Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_stop_service.summary: [Epic WidgetFinder.WidgetFinderSubsystem] Stop mirroring and empty the store, ending the scanning cost. Pending WaitForQuery calls fail at once, and the query tools fail until StartService. Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_stop_widget_lifetime_logging.summary: [Epic UMGEditor.UMGDebuggerSubsystem] Stops recording. Captured events stay queryable until ClearWidgetLifetimeLog or the next start. Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_toggle_widget_as_variable.summary: [Epic UMGToolSet.UMGToolSet] Sets the bIsVariable flag. On UE 5.9 it calls UMGEditor.WidgetBlueprintEditorSubsystem.ToggleWidgetAsVariable.

epic_touch_end.summary: [Epic SlateInspectorToolset.SlateInspectorToolset] Lift a finger held by an earlier TouchStart at an absolute screen position. Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_touch_move.summary: [Epic SlateInspectorToolset.SlateInspectorToolset] Move a finger held by an earlier TouchStart to an absolute screen position. Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_touch_start.summary: [Epic SlateInspectorToolset.SlateInspectorToolset] Put a finger down and leave it there; it shares the left mouse button with the cursor, so do not mix it with a held MouseDown. TouchEnd or ReleaseHeldInput lifts it, as does the hold watchdog after SlateInspectorToolset.HeldInputTimeoutSeconds without a pointer, touch, KeyDown or KeyUp call. Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_trace_widget_property_overrides.summary: [Epic WidgetStaticAnalysisToolset.WidgetStaticAnalysisToolset] Traces every statically-discoverable write to a widget property across the whole tree, merging Blueprint-graph writes with static origins (class defaults, archetype overrides, bindings). Results are grouped per (widget, property) pair. The highest-Order Applied entry is the Winner; earlier entries are Redundant, later ones Conflict. With no Applied entry, the highest-Order entry is an uncertain best guess and all are Conflict. Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_type.summary: [Epic SlateInspectorToolset.SlateInspectorToolset] Type text into a Slate text input widget, focusing it first; use PressKey for keys that are not characters.

epic_unobserve.summary: [Epic SlateInspectorToolset.SlateInspectorToolset] Remove an observer by its identifier.

epic_wait_for.summary: [Epic SlateInspectorToolset.SlateInspectorToolset] Check once whether text is present or absent in the Slate widget tree (substring match); poll to wait.

epic_wait_for_query.summary: [Epic WidgetFinder.WidgetFinderSubsystem] Wait, without polling, until a query's raw match count meets Comparison/Threshold, then return the matches. Prefer it over repeated Query calls and over the SlateInspectorToolset Snapshot/Observe/Screenshot tools. Completes once, with bConditionMet, or with bTimedOut after TimeoutSeconds, which still counts as success. A bad query, a stopped service, or stopping the service mid-wait fails the call. Available on UE 5.9; absent from UE 5.8.

epic_windows.summary: [Epic SlateInspectorToolset.SlateInspectorToolset] List, select, close or resize top-level Slate editor windows. "list" returns a JSON array of {index, ref, title, active, regular, x, y, width, height}. Pass the ref to Screenshot or Snapshot to target that window; the index is positional and changes as windows open and close, the ref does not. "resize" and "maximize" also work under -RenderOffScreen.

epic_wrap_widgets.summary: [Epic UMGToolSet.UMGToolSet] Wraps one or more widgets in a new panel widget of the specified class. Only the root-most widgets in the selection are wrapped - children of other selected widgets are skipped because their parent will be wrapped. Returns info for each newly created wrapper. Use ObjectTools.list_properties on each returned Widget and Slot to discover property names before calling set_properties (padding, alignment, anchors, etc. vary per panel class). On UE 5.9 it calls UMGEditor.WidgetBlueprintEditorSubsystem.WrapWidgets.

params.name: path
params.description: Asset path the lock is keyed by

params.name: sessionId
params.description: Session that holds, or asks for, the lock

params.name: ttlSeconds
params.description: Seconds the lock lasts without renewal

acquire_lock.contractExempt: takes a lock in the editor-wide lock registry

params.name: min
params.description: Box minimum corner, world space

params.name: max
params.description: Box maximum corner, world space; at least min on every axis

params.name: mode
params.description: overlap (default): bounds intersect the box | contained: bounds lie fully inside it

params.name: includeHidden
params.description: Include actors hidden in the queried world (default false)

params.name: classFilter
params.description: Case-insensitive substring over the actor class name

params.name: onlyColliding
params.description: Only colliding components contribute to the bounds (default false)

params.name: limit
params.description: Rows returned (default 200, max 2000)

params.name: world
params.description: World scope: editor (default) | pie
